Total number of questions — 20
Role of Anganwadis
*421. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of WOMEN
AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the genesis, objective and role of
Anganwadis under the Integrated Child
Development Scheme;
(b) the number of the funded tribal and
non-tribal Anganwadis set up, so far in
Rajasthan;
(c) the number of the proposals still
pending for approval;
(d) by when Government are likely to
take a decision;
(e) whether Government propose to
regularize the services of Anganwadi
workers, in due course;
(f) if so, the details thereof;
(g) whether any evaluation of the
performance/success/utility of Anganwadi
Scheme has been done;
(h) if so, the details and outcome thereof;
(i)  whether UNO has also granted funds
for promotion of Anganwadis; and
(j) if so, the details thereof ?
Completion of Power Projects
*422. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
several Power Projects in the country have
not been completed so far;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) whether there is a demand for new
funds for the completion of the incomplete
projects, if so, the State-wise details
thereof ;
(d) whether Government would provide
extra/additional funds for the completion
of the projects and by when these are
expected to be completed; and
(e) the total power expected to be
produced, in megawatts?

132
Private investment in ultra mega
power projects
*423. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are inviting private investment in four ultra
mega power projects in the country;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal and
the private investors who have evinced
interest in the project and terms of
investment; and
(c) the locations where the proposed
ultra mega power projects, would be
established, with details of cost and time-
frame for completion of the projects?
Vision document for development of
SC/STs
*424. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO:
Will the Minister  of  SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are likely to
make strategic shift in the SC/STs
programmes;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Planning Commission is
preparing 10 year Vision Document for SC/
STs;
(d) whether it will also form the base
for chalking out welfare programme for SC/
STs in the eleventh Five Year Plan;
(e) whether Government will consider
preparing such a document for the
development of other vulnerable sections
such as women, children, small and marginal
farmers, disabled etc.;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Demand for additional power by Bihar
†*425. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that on the basis
of peak power demand during current year,
the State Government of Bihar has made a
request to the Central Government for an
additional 600 MW power through National
Thermal Power Corporation;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
NTPC is reluctant to further supply power
to Bihar due to non-payment of its dues;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
quantum of generation of power (in
megawatts) by Bihar itself?
Pilferage of power
*426. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that out of the
total electrical energy generated, around 55
per cent is billed and 20 per cent is lost by
theft, according to a leading magazine;
(b) whether it is also a fact that political
patronage is the main cause for this
pilferage; and
(c) the effective measures envisaged to
check this evil and in what manner and by
when?
Research and development work
*427. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several

Proposals for new roads and bridges
in NER
3021. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) how many proposals from the
North-Eastern States were received by the
Central Government in respect of new
roads and bridges for construction out of
NLCPR fund and NEC fund in the years
2004-05 and 2005-06, State-wise;
(b) how many of them have been
sanctioned and have been provided with
funds;
(c) the names of the roads for which
proposals have been received from Tripura
and their present status;
(d) whether it is a fact that the number
of the projects sanctioned in Tripura is
small in comparison to other States; and
(e) if so, the reason therefor in details?
 Growth of food industry
3022. SHRI B. J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the food industry is
expected to grow at 8-8.5 per cent as per a
study conducted by the industry;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the policy packages
announced by Government to give a further
boost to this industry; and
(d) what is the position of Orissa in
this sector and the action plan of the Centre
to help the State to improve the prospects
of this industry in the rural areas of the
state?
682

683
 Capacity of sea-food processing
industry
3023. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that sea-food
processing industry in the country is
utilising only around 20 per cent of its
capacity;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the steps taken by Government for
reaching full-capacity utilisation with
specific reference to availability of new
material; and
(d) whether Government will consider
to review its policy on sea-food industry
to provide impetus to this industry?
 Wastage due to lack of storage
facilities
3024. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any efforts have been made
by his Ministry to reduce the wastage due
to non-availability of storage facilities in
the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Non-compliance of UGC guidelines
†3025. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the guidelines
of University Grants Commission have not
been complied with in connection with the
admission of students belonging to
Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes in
engineering and medical colleges in Orissa;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the steps being taken by
Government in this direction to ensure
compliance of the guidelines of University
Grants Commission by all States; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Drop-out of girl students
3026. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the current school drop-
out rates of girl students, particularly in
Andhra Pradesh;
(b) the plans with which Government
would address this issue;
(c) whether Government are considering
to incorporate vocational training courses
as part of the course curriculum for reducing
the school drop-out rate; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
 Private universities in the country
†3027. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of private universities in
each State in the country as on the 28th
February, 2006;
(b) the State-wise names of recognised
universities, out of the same;
(c) the criteria for granting recognition;
(d) the names of the private universities
wherein proper inspections were made to
